'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Steve Baroni LS Mind What You Have Learned (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned (V) / Save You It Can (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
